software.title: Software
software.description: Applications, packages, browser and IDE extensions and AI models Falcon Discover has found on your devices.

typeHelp.application: A program installed on the device, as reported by the Falcon sensor.
typeHelp.browser_extension: An extension installed in a web browser. Extensions can read page content, so Falcon flags risky ones.
typeHelp.dev_package: A library installed through a package manager such as npm or pip. Outdated packages are a common source of vulnerabilities.
typeHelp.ide_extension: A plug-in installed in a code editor.
typeHelp.llm: A local AI model found on the device.
typeHelp.mcp: A Model Context Protocol server that lets AI tools reach local files or services.

empty.none: No software was found as of the last complete update.
empty.unknown: No software to show. The inventory is not complete, so this does not mean there is none.

sheet.title: Software
sheet.notFoundHelp: This item is not in the inventory of this organization.
